title: ProjectHub — Whose Task Is It Really?
objective: You belong to one project. Read a task that belongs to a project you are not a member of.

verifier.condition: A task belonging to a project the signed-in user is not a member of is returned from GET /api/projects/:pid/tasks/:tid, where :pid is a project the user does belong to.

weakness: The API checks membership of the parent project in the URL but loads the child task globally, never confirming the task belongs to that project.
seededData: Users alice (project 1) and bob (project 2); a few tasks per project, one of them confidential. In-memory.

credentials.label: Project member
credentials.note: You are a member of project 1 only.

hints: The URL contains two ids. Which of them does the server actually verify against your membership?
Task ids are global across projects, not numbered per project.
burpNotes: Send a legitimate task request to Repeater and study which parts of the URL the server seems to care about.
